notes: Capacity is logistical potential; starting Taverns and Victualling Yards additionally require deficit/surplus and available workers.
Tavern coefficients are 1.5x the former 90-food Victualler caps, so a location can still take in the same food at 60 food per level.

The Victualling Yard (harbour, burghers) ships in grain and packs a little of the store: its cap is harbour capacity (natural harbour, river mouth and harbour buildings) x harbor_capacity + market centre + development, minus the threshold, at least minimum on a Yard site and 0 elsewhere. Most sites hold one level; great harbours, market centres and ports with docks more.
River road state is read from the navigation map variables updated on completion and destruction.
All coefficients are balance choices; no location is hardcoded as a Tavern or Victualling Yard site.

Victualling Yard sites (2026-09-26): not a cold climate, and natural harbour suitability >= sea_harbor next to real sea (a water neighbour without the river navigation variable) or >= any_harbor anywhere. The engine's harbour value includes river_flowing_through_coast (+0.05 per river size), river ports count as coastal. Fitted on historic ports vs empty regions: 1,205 sites, 85 of 98 historic hubs.
The Grange is the overland twin: province capitals that are not Yard sites; its cap grows with roads, market centres and development, and its level cost is steep.

Inland market centres (2026-10-03): a market centre that is not a Yard site may hold a small Yard too: inland_market_center.water levels with river or sea access (is_coastal: river and channel banks count), .land without, plus development x .development, at most .maximum. It ships market grain into victuals, so a dear victuals price reaches the farms of an inland market.

Victualling Yard (2026-10-04, Jan): harbour capacity counts x8 (was x4). The Staple Port carries local_victualling_yard_building_levels = 3 and the Grand Staple Port 8 (in_game/common/town_rights/pp_town_rights.txt, shown on the town right like the marketplace levels); the cap adds that modifier on a Yard site and at a market centre alike. No upper limit since 2026-10-04 (Jan; was 10 on a Yard site, 4 at an inland market centre); an optional maximum key brings it back.
